newsitem.title: HONG KONG: CITIC Beijing launches US$200 mln FRN.
newsitem.headline: CITIC Beijing launches US$200 mln FRN.

text.p: China International Trust and Investment Corp (CITIC) has launched a US$200 million floating rate note issue due 2002, said lead manager and bookrunner CS First Boston.
The notes were priced and re-offered at par to float at 35 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
